content.title: 2026 NFL Draft order for all seven rounds
content.text: This is a round-by-round list of every pick in the 2026 NFL Draft, No. 1 through No. 257. But first, a few details about this year's event:When is the 2026 NFL Draft?Round 1: Thursday, April 23, beginning at 8 p.m. ET.Rounds 2 and 3: Friday, April 24, beginning at 7 p.m. ET.Rounds 4 through 7: Saturday, April 25, beginning at noon ET.Where will this year's draft be held?The 2026 NFL Draft will take place in Pittsburgh, in the lots surrounding Acrisure Stadium and Point State Park.182.
